name: temple-of-the-z
title: Legend of Now – Temple of Z
description: Agent interface for the browser game Legend of Now – Temple of Z. Observe a compact world state, latch movement and combat actions, and advance a fixed timestep so a bot can play with no screen. Human keyboard, touch, and gamepad play is unchanged when agent and headless flags are off.

flags.agent: Start in step mode. The simulation advances only via window.game.step(n). Rendering still runs so a person can watch.
flags.headless: Step mode, plus skip drawing, shadows, bloom, and cosmetic particle updates. Character animation is reduced to gameplay timers. Use this for a bot with no screen.
flags.seed: Seed relic, wisdom, and chaser randomness. Example: ?seed=1. Replay requires step mode (frame timing in realtime mode changes the spawn rolls).
flags.bot: After load, run the built-in reference bot. Optional &levels=1 and &maxTicks=7000.

methods.ready: Promise resolved when models are loaded and the menu is up.
methods.act: Apply a string action or a move object. Returns {ok, error?}.
methods.step: step(n) simulates n ticks of fixedDt seconds and returns the observation. Switches to step mode.
methods.setSeed: setSeed(seed, {restart}). Seed applies on the next level load.
methods.setDrive: setDrive("realtime" | "step") gives the frame clock control again or takes it back.

stdio: JSON lines on stdin: {"id":1,"method":"getState|act|step|listActions|setSeed|manifest|runBot","params":{}}. One JSON response line per request.
mcp: stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 (Content-Length framing or a single JSON line). tools/list returns the tools array. tools/call name is get_state, list_actions, act, step, set_seed, or run_bot.

actions.name: start
actions.description: Leave the menu and play the current level. On the win screen this returns to the level 1 menu instead of starting.

actions.name: restart
actions.description: Reset score and lives, clear latched input, and return to the level 1 menu. The current seed is kept and replayed.

actions.name: pause
actions.description: Pause a running game. Time does not advance while paused.

actions.name: forward
actions.description: Latch movement forward, along the facing direction. Leaves strafe and turn unchanged.

actions.name: back
actions.description: Latch movement backward. Leaves strafe and turn unchanged.

actions.name: strafe_left
actions.description: Latch strafe to the player's left.

actions.name: strafe_right
actions.description: Latch strafe to the player's right.

actions.name: turn_left
actions.description: Latch a full-rate left turn. Yaw increases at 2.4 rad/s. Yaw 0 faces -Z; positive yaw turns toward +X.

actions.name: turn_right
actions.description: Latch a full-rate right turn. Yaw decreases at 2.4 rad/s.

actions.name: fire
actions.description: Fire one bolt along the current heading on the next tick. One-shot; not latched. Bolts travel 16 units/s and hit a chaser within 1.2 units horizontally.

actions.name: now_shift
actions.description: Spend the Now-shift if the meter is full. One-shot. For 2 seconds of real time the world (including the level clock and bolts) runs at 1/4 speed while the player keeps 90% speed. Then an 8 second cooldown.

actions.name: move
actions.description: Set any combination of latched axes and optional one-shot fire/shift. Unspecified axes are left as they were. Values are clamped to [-1, 1].

args.forward: number -1..1. Positive moves forward at full speed (8 units/s).
args.turn: number -1..1. Positive turns left at up to 2.4 rad/s.
args.fire: boolean. Fire once on the next tick.
args.shift: boolean. Try Now-shift once on the next tick.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Observe Legend of Now – Temple of Z. Returns level, objectives, score, lives, time left, player pose, and nearby chasers, pickups, portal, NPC, and boss with positions relative to the player. Reading state drains the event queue.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List every action the game accepts.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Apply one action. String names latch a single channel (forward, back, strafe_left, strafe_right, turn_left, turn_right) or fire a one-shot (fire, now_shift) or control the session (start, restart, pause, resume, stop). An object sets move axes: {forward, strafe, turn, fire, shift}. Movement persists until changed; call step() to simulate.

action.description: Action name (string) or a move object {forward, strafe, turn, fire, shift}.

tools.name: step
tools.description: Advance the simulation by n fixed timesteps (1/30 s each), independent of the display frame rate. Switches the session into step mode. Optional action is applied first. Returns the new observation.

action.description: Optional action to apply before stepping. Same shapes as act.

tools.name: set_seed
tools.description: Set the gameplay RNG seed used for relic coins, wisdom crystals, and chaser spawns. The seed is applied the next time a level loads. Pass restart true to reload level 1 immediately.

seed.description: Number or string. Same seed replays the same level layout in step mode.

restart.description: When true, reset to the level 1 menu so the seed applies now.

tools.name: run_bot
tools.description: Run the built-in heuristic reference bot via the agent API until it clears the requested number of levels, fails, or exhausts maxTicks.

maxTicks.description: Cap on fixed timesteps. Default is chosen by the runner.

seed.description: Optional seed. When set, the game restarts onto that seed before the bot runs.

observation.description: Compact JSON observation returned by get_state and step.

drive.description: realtime follows the display frame. step advances only when step() is called.

tick.description: Fixed or realtime frames simulated since this page loaded.

outcome.description: Set when a level ends. Cleared means the level was completed and the menu is now showing the next one. Stays until the next start or restart.

levelsCleared.description: How many levels have been completed this run. 3 means the legend is finished.

index.description: 0-based index of the level currently loaded.

boss.description: Null until the Threshold Guardian is on the field.

ready.description: True when the level completion conditions are already met.

timeLeft.description: Seconds left on the level clock. Drains with world time, so Now-shift slows it.

meter.description: 0..1. Full and not active means Now-shift is ready.

yaw.description: Radians. 0 faces -Z. Positive turn_left increases yaw toward +X.

nearby.description: Entities include world x,z and player-relative dx, dz, dist, and bearing. Bearing is signed radians; positive means the target is to the left (turn_left). Lists are sorted nearest first. Chasers are living only. Pickups are uncollected.

events.description: Events since the previous get_state: coin, wisdom, enemy_down, hurt, boss_hit, boss_down, now_shift, level_cleared, level_failed, game_won.

coordinates: World XZ plane, Y is up and unused for movement. The player starts at (0, 0) facing -Z (toward the temple). Pickup radius is about 0.8 on the ground. Touching a chaser costs a life and defeats that chaser. Three lives. Running out of lives or time fails the level.
